name: Genesis 2:4b–3:24 (Eden / non-Priestly creation account)

surviving_manuscript_date.note: No physical-witness date is assigned in this batch rather than conflating the text's literary formation with later surviving manuscripts.

tradition_internal_claim.note: The narrative is set in primordial Eden and supplies no calendar date for its events.

estimated_oral_origin.method: David M. Carr argues that parts of the Eden story may reflect earlier oral/literary precursors, but the evidence does not support an absolute oral-origin date.

dating.dating_summary: Genesis 2:4b–3:24 is widely treated as a non-Priestly creation/Eden account distinct from Genesis 1. Its earliest layer is difficult to date securely, so this record leaves composition undated rather than forcing a false point or century.

notes: Carr's 2020 formation model treats the Eden story as the likely opening of an early independent non-Priestly primeval history; the exact dating of that layer remains poorly constrained.
